title: CIMTester - template-based BIST compiler for digital compute-in-memory
problem: Testing compute-in-memory (CIM) systems requires comprehensive fault coverage at the circuit level. Traditional BIST (Built-In Self-Test) techniques don't directly apply to CIM's unique computational memory architecture.
motivation: A template-based BIST compiler can systematically generate test patterns for CIM arrays by encoding domain knowledge about CIM faults and leveraging hardware synthesis to produce efficient test circuits.
method: CIMTester provides a compiler framework that generates BIST circuits for digital CIM systems using templates encoding common fault models and test strategies, synthesizing efficient test circuits tailored to CIM array architecture.
key_novelty: Template-based BIST compiler specifically designed for compute-in-memory systems, enabling comprehensive fault testing.
contributions: Template-based BIST compilation framework for CIM systems
99.48% fault coverage for digital compute-in-memory arrays
Automated test circuit generation for memory-compute architectures
limitations: Template coverage for emerging CIM architectures may be incomplete, and generated BIST circuits could have significant area overhead.
